about_the_game:
Survive a Hostile Universe

Stranded alone after a failed experimental hyperspace jump, you must navigate a dangerous, alien-filled universe. Every encounter is a fight for survival.

Assemble Your Ship and Weapons

Choose from a variety of ship parts and weapon components to create your loadout. Experiment with different combinations to find the setup that fits your playstyle and strategy.

Collect and Progress

Scavenge energy across hazardous environments to reactivate your drive and attempt the jump back home. Resource management and smart planning are crucial.

Roguelike Combat

Face relentless alien foes in tense, twin-stick shooter combat. No two runs are ever the same, and every battle tests your reflexes, strategy, and adaptability.
